criteria.requirement: Extend existing _serialize_value container handling to frozenset and collections.deque using existing pydantic_core.to_jsonable_python before JSON encoding. Real CliApp.serialize/run roundtrip must preserve values and model container types; deque order and duplicates remain, frozenset order is not promised. Complete JSON-array arguments for these two containers must decode JSON escapes exactly once, including Unicode, quotes, newlines and backslashes, retaining the existing numeric-string coercion. Cover empty containers replacing nonempty defaults, commas and enum members. Existing shorthand input, NoDecode, list/dict/set/tuple and scalar policies remain.

Investigate the real source, explain the call path and clarify the business requirements before obtaining plan approval and implementing. Deliver real engineering changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. Repair independently reported failures; questions, answers and documentation do not count as separate completed objectives.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual business behavior and the frozen scope; do not grade by matching the reference patch text.
